description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the RabbitMQPublisherActor, testing message publishing, acknowledgements, and interaction with a RabbitMQ channel in the context of a messaging service within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RabbitMQPublisherActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for RabbitMQPublisherActor, testing message publishing, acknowledgement handling, and channel interactions

methods.name: testMultipleAcknowledgements
methods.description: Tests handling of multiple message acknowledgements with mixed success and failure statuses.

methods.name: setupMocks
methods.description: Sets up mock dependencies for the test environment.

methods.name: publisherCreated
methods.description: Helper method to simulate publisher actor creation and link it with a channel created event.

methods.name: getPublisherActorProps
methods.description: Provides Props configuration for creating the RabbitMQPublisherActor.

methods.name: verifyAcknowledgements
methods.description: Verifies that acknowledgements are correctly processed and interpreted.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessage
methods.description: Checks that a message was correctly published to the channel with proper headers.

methods.name: verifyPublishedMessageToReplyTarget
methods.description: Checks message publishing to a reply target with correct headers.

methods.name: decorateTarget
methods.description: Wraps or modifies the target; returns the target unmodified in this case.

methods.name: setUpPublishConfirmMode
methods.description: Prepares a mocked channel in confirm mode with a confirm listener for test assertions.
